# GENERATED by tools/gen_st_recommender.py. Edit the generator, not this file.
#
# Root and this = the player. Saved scopes: st_rec_c (partner country),
# st_rec_g (goods), st_rec_h / st_rec_p (home / partner market goods).
# Mirrors vanilla's goods_transfer article (13_goods_transfer.txt), plus
# "not at war" and "not already moving this good between us" (spec). The
# partner's base acceptance is checked once known (Damien, 2026-11-13).
st_rec_pair_ok = {
	NOT = { this = scope:st_rec_c }
	NOT = { has_war_with = scope:st_rec_c }
	scope:st_rec_c = { is_junior_in_customs_union = no }
	is_market_reachable_for_trade = scope:st_rec_c.market
	OR = {
		var:st_rec_adj > 0
		AND = {
			any_scope_state = { has_port_state = yes }
			scope:st_rec_c = { any_scope_state = { has_port_state = yes } }
		}
	}
	OR = {
		supply_network_strength >= 0.75
		is_adjacent_to_country = scope:st_rec_c
	}
	NOT = {
		any_scope_treaty = {
			binds = scope:st_rec_c
			any_scope_article = {
				has_type = goods_transfer
				input_goods = scope:st_rec_g
			}
		}
	}
	scope:st_rec_p = { treaty_imports < market_import_cap }
	scope:st_rec_h = { treaty_exports < market_export_cap }
	# Base acceptance, computed for every market owner at the start of the
	# scan (st_rec_scan); an unknown never filters.
	scope:st_rec_c = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = st_rec_acc }
			var:st_rec_acc >= 0
		}
	}
}

# Both capitals on the same continent (vanilla's geographic regions), for the
# shipping route factor (st_rec_route). A capital in none of the five counts
# as far, the higher cost.
st_rec_same_continent = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe }
			scope:st_rec_c = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe } }
		}
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas }
			scope:st_rec_c = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas } }
		}
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa }
			scope:st_rec_c = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa } }
		}
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia }
			scope:st_rec_c = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia } }
		}
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_oceania }
			scope:st_rec_c = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_oceania } }
		}
	}
}

# The same test for the treaty draft (st_far_route_sgui): root and this = one
# country, scope:st_other = the other.
st_same_continent_as_other = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe }
			scope:st_other = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe } }
		}
		AND = {
			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas }
			scope:st_other = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas } }
		}

			capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa }
			scope:st_other = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa } }

# The same test for a treaty article (the losing-transfer alert,
# st_alert_values.txt): its sender's and receiver's capitals.
st_article_same_continent = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			source_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe } }
			target_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe } }
		}
		AND = {
			source_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas } }
			target_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_americas } }
		}
		AND = {
			source_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa } }
			target_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_africa } }
		}
		AND = {
			source_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia } }
			target_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_asia } }
		}

			source_country = { capital ?= { is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_oceania } }
